title: Dirichlet Eigenvalues for the Logarithmic-Hardy operator
summary: In this paper, we study the Dirichlet eigenvalue problem for the logarithmic Hardy operator, defined as the logarithmic Laplacian with a critical logarithmic potential, in a bounded Lipschitz domain containing the origin. We first establish a logarithmic Hardy inequality and use it to identify the associated energy space, showing that the embedding into \(L^2\) is compact when the perturbation parameter exceeds the endpoint value \(-1\), but fails to be compact at that endpoint.
